changelog.summary: Account lockout after failed logins + remove all hardcoded JWT secret fallbacks

changes.description: LoginAttemptsService: in-memory account lockout — 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes triggers a 30-minute lockout for that email address
Lockout wired into UnifiedAuthService (admin + customer login) and CustomersService (dedicated customer login endpoint)
Removed all remaining || 'ltic-secret' JWT secret fallbacks from customers.service.ts and unified-auth.service.ts — all tokens now strictly require SESSION_SECRET env var

changelog.summary: Full responsive design across all public pages, admin panel, and shared components

changes.description: Admin panel: mobile drawer sidebar with hamburger menu and backdrop overlay, visible on all screen sizes
All admin pages: responsive padding (p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8), responsive headings (text-2xl sm:text-3xl), overflow-x-auto tables with min-width
All public hero sections: responsive headings (text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl) and body text (text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl)
Landing page: responsive hero heading scale, smaller decorative orbs on mobile, responsive section headings and stats
About page: responsive stats (text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl), responsive section padding (py-16 sm:py-20 lg:py-24), responsive card padding
Categories page: sm:grid-cols-2 breakpoint added, responsive skeleton height, responsive gap
WhatsApp button: smaller position on mobile (bottom-4 right-4 sm:bottom-6 sm:right-6), smaller button size on mobile
SocialBar: flex-wrap added so icons wrap on small screens; gap reduced on mobile
Footer: bottom legal links now flex-wrap on very small screens

Fixed encoding corruption in 6 public page files (about, contact, news, products, quote, services, tracking) — French accented characters (é, è, à, ç, É, À, —) were double-encoded by a previous PowerShell script using the wrong encoding

changelog.summary: Fix blank product detail page — fetch by slug directly, sanitize slugs

changes.description: Product detail page now fetches the product directly by slug via GET /api/products/:slug instead of loading all 200 products and searching client-side — eliminates blank page when slug has spaces or encoding differences
Products API: sanitizeSlug() now normalizes slugs on both create and update — spaces, accents, and special characters are converted to dashes automatically
Fixed product id=24 in DB: bad slug 'the art of the year' (with spaces) corrected to 'african-iroko-timber-2'

changelog.summary: Fix next/image error for uploaded media from local API

changes.description: Added localhost:4000/uploads/** to next.config.mjs remotePatterns so uploaded product/category/news images render correctly without crashing

changelog.summary: Fix product creation 500 error — validation + error handling

changes.description: Products API: catch PostgreSQL errors and return meaningful HTTP responses (409 for duplicate slug, 400 for missing category/name, 400 for invalid foreign key)
Products API: auto-generate slug from name if not provided, so missing slug no longer causes a crash
Product form: show inline validation error if category is not selected before submitting
Product form: slug auto-fills from the product name as you type — no more manual slug entry required

changelog.summary: Full EN/FR translation across all admin pages

changes.description: Admin sidebar nav labels (Dashboard, Products, Categories, Quotes, Orders, News, Contacts, Settings, Changelog, My Profile, Notifications, Logout) now switch language with the EN/FR toggle
Quotes page: all text translated (title, column headers, status options, empty state)
Orders page: all text translated (title, column headers, status options, empty state)
Contacts page: all text translated (title, Email/Phone labels, Mark as Read/Unread, empty state)
Settings page: all text translated (title, section header, button labels, toast messages)
Changelog page: all text translated (title, stats labels, type badges Feature/Fix/Improvement/Breaking, Latest badge, New Release form)
Profile page: all text translated (section titles, field labels, button labels, security reminder card)

changelog.summary: Fix language toggle on admin dashboard + fix file uploads

changes.description: Admin dashboard now responds to EN/FR language toggle — all strings (title, stat labels, section headers) are translated via useLanguage()
File/image uploads fixed — downgraded multer from v2 to v1.4.5-lts.1 (NestJS FileInterceptor is incompatible with multer v2 API)

changelog.summary: Remove admin redirect hint from login page for security

changes.description: Login page: removed 'Administrators are redirected to the admin dashboard automatically' hint to avoid revealing role-detection behavior to potential attackers

changelog.summary: Unified login page, role-based redirection, secure admin profile settings

changes.description: Single login page at /auth/login handles both admins and customers — POST /api/auth/login checks admin_profile first, then customers table; returns role in response
Role-based redirection after login: admin → /admin/dashboard, customer → /account; supports ?redirect= query param
AuthGuard now rejects customer tokens (role: 'customer') from accessing admin routes — closes privilege escalation gap
Admin email change secured: PATCH /api/admin/profile/email requires current password verification (bcrypt) before updating
Admin profile page redesigned into four sections: avatar, display name, email address (with password confirmation), change password
Password minimum length raised to 8 characters; bcrypt cost raised from 10 to 12
/admin now redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login instead of showing a separate login form
AdminSidebar redirects to /auth/login (not /admin) on token expiry or auth failure

changelog.summary: Admin email+password login via DB profile, auto-push workflow, CLAUDE.md

changes.description: Admin login now accepts email + password validated against admin_profile table (bcrypt); falls back to ADMIN_PASSWORD env var until a password is set via the Profile page
Admin login page: username field replaced with email field (with Mail icon); helpful hint pointing to Profile page for credential changes
GET /api/admin/me now returns the admin's display name from admin_profile instead of the raw token claim
ADMIN_EMAIL env var seeds the initial admin_profile email on first startup (default: admin@ltic-sarl.com)
CLAUDE.md added — instructs future Claude sessions to auto-push changes to GitHub with version control after every task

changelog.summary: Auto-translation in admin forms + admin email and dashboard notifications

changes.description: Admin forms (Products, Categories, News) now show a single-language input — the other language is auto-translated via MyMemory API on save
Translating spinner shown while the translation is in progress; admin language is determined by the sidebar language toggle
New admin_notifications table created automatically on API startup (no migration step needed)
New quote requests and contact messages now create a dashboard notification and optionally send an email to the admin
Email notifications via nodemailer — configure MAIL_HOST, MAIL_USER, MAIL_PASS, ADMIN_EMAIL in .env; email is silently skipped if not configured
Notifications page at /admin/notifications: unread badge, mark as read, mark all read, delete, 30-second auto-refresh
AdminSidebar: Bell icon with live red unread count badge, polling every 30 seconds

changelog.summary: Media upload from device in admin panel for products, categories, and news

changes.description: New POST /api/upload endpoint (admin-protected) — accepts images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG) and videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WebM) up to 100 MB, stored in uploads/media/
MediaUpload component: two tabs — 'Upload from device' (drag-and-drop or click to browse) and 'Paste URL'; shows live image/video preview with clear button
Admin products form: Image URL text field replaced with MediaUpload component
Admin categories form: Image URL text field replaced with MediaUpload component
Admin news form: Image URL text field replaced with MediaUpload component

changelog.summary: Auto-translation in admin panel - product and category names follow website language

changes.description: AdminSidebar: EN/FR language toggle button added at the bottom - switches language for the entire admin panel
Admin products table: product name and availability status now display in the current language (EN/FR)
Admin products form: category dropdown shows category names in current language
Admin categories table: Name column shows current language, Translation column shows the other language

changelog.summary: Removed Request a Quote button from About page bottom CTA

changes.description: About page: removed Request a Quote button from bottom CTA, leaving only the solid white Contact Our Team button

changelog.summary: Fixed Contact Our Team button on About page CTA

changes.description: About page: Contact Our Team button replaced broken outline-white style with semi-transparent white background + white border, visually distinct from the solid white Request a Quote button

changelog.summary: Real flag images in country selector and phone input dial code dropdown

changes.description: CountrySelect: replaced emoji flags with flagcdn.com images (w20/w40 srcset) - renders correctly on Windows
PhoneInput: replaced emoji flags with flagcdn.com images in both the dial code button and the country search dropdown

changelog.summary: Country selector converted to searchable combobox with type-to-filter

changes.description: CountrySelect is now a combobox: users can type to filter countries, select from dropdown, or clear with the X button
Updated all 4 form call sites (register, profile, quote, contact) to match new onChange(value: string) signature

changelog.summary: Country-aware phone validation, email format indicator, and country select across all forms

changes.description: New lib/countries.ts: 52 countries with dial codes, flag emojis, and phone regex patterns
PhoneInput component: country dial code selector (searchable dropdown) + local number input with per-country format validation indicator
CountrySelect component: reusable dropdown with flag emojis, EN/FR placeholder support
EmailInput component: real-time email format validation with green check / red X indicator on blur
Register form: EmailInput + CountrySelect + PhoneInput (dial code auto-synced with country)
Account profile form: CountrySelect + PhoneInput replacing old plain inputs
Quote form: CountrySelect dropdown replaces text input; PhoneInput with country sync via react-hook-form Controller
Contact form: added CountrySelect + PhoneInput; EmailInput replaces plain email input

changelog.summary: WhatsApp contact button on product detail page

changes.description: Added WhatsApp button on product detail page that opens a chat with a pre-filled message mentioning the product name

changelog.summary: Navbar Request Quote restored (hidden on landing page only) + services page CTA cleanup

changes.description: Request Quote button restored in navbar, visible on all pages except the landing page
Removed Request Quote button from services page bottom CTA
Services page bottom CTA: Contact Our Team changed to solid white button matching design system

changelog.summary: Removed Request Quote button from navbar on all pages

changes.description: Removed 'Request Quote' button from desktop navbar (unauthenticated state)
Removed 'Request Quote' button from mobile navbar menu

changelog.summary: Landing page hero and CTA button cleanup

changes.description: Removed 'Contact Our Team' ghost button from hero section - hero now has two focused CTAs only
Removed duplicate 'Request a Quote' button from bottom CTA section
Fixed 'Contact Our Team' button at bottom CTA - replaced broken outline/white style with solid white button matching design system

changelog.summary: Professional cookie consent system + version control

changes.description: Full cookie consent service with 4 categories (Essential, Functional, Analytics, Marketing)
Cookie preferences modal with per-category toggles and detailed cookie listing
Floating cookie settings button with confirmation feedback
Live consent manager on /cookies policy page with withdraw support
Version control system with semantic versioning and changelog
Admin changelog page at /admin/changelog
GET /api/version endpoint returning version info and full changelog

changelog.summary: Customer registration, authentication, and admin profile management

changes.description: Customer registration and login with JWT authentication
Customer account area: dashboard, orders, quotes, profile settings
Customer profile editing: name, phone, country, company, avatar upload
Customer password change with current password verification
Admin profile management: name, email, avatar upload, password change
File upload service for profile pictures stored in /uploads/
Navbar user menu with dropdown for authenticated customers

changelog.summary: Initial production release of LTIC SARL website

changes.description: Complete public website: Home, About, Services, Products, Categories, Quote, Tracking, News, Contact, Legal pages
Full admin panel: Dashboard, Products, Categories, Quotes, Orders, News, Contacts, Settings
Bilingual EN/FR support throughout all pages
PostgreSQL database with Drizzle ORM — 7 core tables seeded with real data
